paragraphs: George’s Oasis takes its name from George Sitaras. The public website describes a family tradition continued by the children and later generations of George and Harriet Sitaras.
John, Debbie, and Kelly are part of the family story described on the restaurant’s existing website. The family’s connection to food and time together is central to the Oasis tradition.
